comics.title: Rust owns the mailbox, Python owns the loop
comics.caption: A queue plus a pipe byte joins them. The byte is only a hint; the queue is the truth.

comics.title: Who owns the thread?
comics.caption: Async: the thread lives inside the loop. Sync: the loop lives inside the thread, and only wakes up when called.

comics.title: How handle.get() wakes up
comics.caption: No asyncio loop, no pipe, no busy polling: a watch channel, a waker, and a blocked thread with the GIL released.

comics.title: How await handle wakes the asyncio loop
comics.caption: The byte wakes the loop; the token says which await completed. The Tokio observer never runs the Python coroutine.
